name: 33070 · Tavernier, FL
findings: ZIP 33070 (Tavernier) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33070 (Tavernier) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33070 (Tavernier) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
